elements.requirement: Every individual possesses a right to be free from harassment.
elements.quote: Every individual has a right to be free from harassment

elements.requirement: A person must not engage in conduct amounting to harassment of another individual where that conduct is intended to amount to harassment of that individual.
elements.quote: a person must not engage in conduct which amounts to harassment of another and— (a) is intended to amount to harassment of that person

elements.requirement: A person must not engage in conduct amounting to harassment of another individual where that conduct occurs in circumstances in which a reasonable person would consider it to amount to harassment of that individual.
elements.quote: occurs in circumstances where it would appear to a reasonable person that it would amount to harassment of that person

elements.requirement: The prohibition on conduct amounting to harassment applies only if the conduct amounts to domestic abuse.
elements.quote: Subsection (1) only applies where the conduct referred to amounts to domestic abuse.

elements.requirement: Subsections (2) to (7) of section 8 apply in relation to subsection (1) as they apply in relation to subsection (1) of section 8, subject to specific modifications.
elements.quote: Subsections (2) to (7) of section 8 apply in relation to subsection (1) as they apply in relation to subsection (1) of that section but with the following modifications

elements.requirement: The words “course of” are omitted from subsections (2) and (4) of section 8 as applied.
elements.quote: in subsections (2) and (4), the words “course of” are omitted

elements.requirement: For the purposes of the section, conduct may involve behaviour on one or more than one occasion.
elements.quote: “conduct”––may involve behaviour on one or more than one occasion

elements.requirement: For the purposes of the section, conduct includes speech as well as presence in any place or area.
elements.quote: includes— speech; andpresence in any place or area

elements.requirement: For the purposes of the section, harassment of a person includes causing that person alarm or distress.
elements.quote: “harassment” of a person includes causing the person alarm or distress.

elements.requirement: In subsection (4)(b) of section 8 as applied, the words “ engaged in ” are substituted for the word “pursued”.
elements.quote: in subsection (4)(b), for “pursued” substitute “ engaged in ”

thresholds.what: minimum number of occasions of behaviour that conduct may involve
thresholds.quote: behaviour on one or more than one occasion
